title: Gaussian noise on Hermite functions
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\alpha=(\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_n)\in\mathbb N^n$, and let $\rho\in[-1,1]$. For the multivariate normalized Hermite function $H_\alpha$ on $\mathbb R^n$, Gaussian noise of correlation $\rho$ acts by
\[T_\rho H_\alpha=\rho^{\alpha_1+\cdots+\alpha_n}H_\alpha.\]
